summary: Both round-1 findings are resolved. The legacy guard now rejects only a non-empty `files` array, and a temp test confirms that a text-only prompt with `files: []` is still accepted. Uploads now abort when the pane unmounts and show progress, and I verified that Stop is hidden while a message is sending (`showStop` requires `!composerBusy`), so it cannot be clicked during an upload. The new temp tests are thorough and all pass. The only remaining blocker is the coverage gate: 5 changed lines have no test and no exemption.

testRequests.target: packages/web/src/main/agent/AgentPane.tsx:288: withdrawing a queued message restores its files to the composer
testRequests.rationale: This line changed and is not covered. The durable E2E 'moves one queued message and its attachments and references into the existing draft' in apps/electron/e2e/sessionView.e2e.test.ts exercises it. Run that E2E in the temp tier, or add an equivalent temp E2E.

testRequests.target: packages/workspace-server/src/uploads/UploadService.ts:224: when a claim fails and restoring the uploads claimed before it also fails, the service logs 'Could not restore claimed uploads'
testRequests.rationale: This line is uncovered. Extend the existing rollback temp test by also injecting a staging mkdir or rename failure during the restore, or add a coverage exemption with a reason.

testRequests.target: packages/workspace-server/src/uploads/UploadService.ts:327: when expiry cleanup fails, the service logs 'Could not remove an expired upload'
testRequests.rationale: This line is uncovered. Add an rm failure to the fake-timer expiry temp test, or add a coverage exemption with a reason.

testRequests.target: packages/client/src/uploadChatFile.ts:113-114: wait() returns a cancellation right away when the signal is already aborted
testRequests.rationale: These lines are uncovered. uploadError() already returns ChatUploadCancelledError once the signal is aborted, so this branch is reachable only through a race. A coverage exemption with that reason is acceptable; otherwise add a test.
